name: Google Cloud Tasks

evidence.jobs: C02: managed asynchronous task queue with retries and scheduling; J04: one-time schedule up to 30 days ahead

line: Schedule and dispatch HTTP tasks to your own worker endpoints.

free.text: 1M ops/month; queue inactive after 30 idle days; tasks deleted at 31 days

cells.regions: Queue regions: Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, Middle East

sql.math: Cloud Tasks is a queue service, not a database
Cloud Tasks is a queue service, not a database

files.math: Cloud Tasks does not provide file storage.

jobs.math: 10,000 tasks at the maximum size of 1 MiB, each with 32 units and 2 calls, make 640,000 operations. That is within the 1 million free operations. Worker and transfer costs are unknown.
